matter_background.original: By a final decree dated 20th October 2001 entered in the District Court of Homagama Partition Case No.2026/P land and premises bearing Assessment No.12, Rajamalwatta Road, Panagoda depicted as Lot A in Partition Plan No.2111 dated 23rd May 2001 made by A.L. Jayaweera Licensed Surveyor in extent 20 perches was allotted to Sujeewa Jayamini. She was married to Thilak Gamage and had 2 children namely Dinesh and Iresh. By Deed of Gift No.1100 dated 12th January 2006 attested by Asanka Silva Notary Public, the said Lot A was gifted to her son Dinesh Gamage as an absolute and irrevocable gift subject to life interest of the said Donor Sujeewa Jayamini. Sujeewa Jayamini died on 21 April 2007. Dinesh had a daughter named Neesha by his first wife Nimali. Nimali died on 15th July 2010. Dinesh died intestate on 23rd November 2009 leaving his second wife Lochana and three children namely Kasun, Kavindu and Piyumi. Neesha Gamage married Rohan Jayaweera and died intestate on 20th May 2012 without leaving children. Kasun Gamage died of cancer on 5th July 2015 unmarried and issueless.
